summary: I think the policy for my #highered syllabi will be "notification free zone." I would never go device free. Cutting yourself off from knowledge seems silly. Reducing distractions, smart. Also privacy especially with iMessage desktop notifications. Seen some embarrassing moments. Luckily none projected yet.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I think the policy for my #highered syllabi will be "notification free zone." I would never go device free. Cutting yourself off from knowledge seems silly.

Reducing distractions, smart.

Also privacy especially with iMessage desktop notifications. Seen some embarrassing moments. Luckily none projected yet.
